notes: Also sold without CAC reader as F1DN104KVM-UNN4 (identical port set; CAC port present but non-functional/covered on the -UNN4 variant). This is the "2nd Gen" (PP 4.0 certified) successor to the F1DN104KVM-UN-3. Desktop enclosure; rack-mount brackets (F1D006) are an optional accessory, not integrated rack ears, so rackUnits is omitted. The 4 computer-side DP/HDMI combo ports and the 1 console-side DP/HDMI combo port are physically HDMI-type female connectors that also accept a DisplayPort cable per the manual ("video connectors can accept a DisplayPort or HDMI cable") - modeled as connector "hdmi" with accepts:["dp"]. Grade set to hdmi-2.0 per spec table ("HDMI 2.0 and DisplayPort 1.2 ports support UHD 4K resolutions of up to 3840x2160 @60Hz"); DP side of the combo is capped at DP 1.2. USB-B "computer" ports are upstream links to the connected PC (functionally KM/CAC uplinks, not host ports), so direction is set to bidirectional as instructed for USB host-type ports; console-side USB-A keyboard/mouse/CAC ports are inputs (peripherals plug in). The "RC port" (remote desktop controller accessory jack) is a small modular jack; prior-gen (-UN-3) datasheet documents the equivalent port as "RJ25" which is not in the allowed connector list, so it is mapped to the closest available id, rj45, as a control port - treat this mapping as a caveat. Power: external 12V/2.5A DC brick with worldwide interchangeable AC mains adapters; the unit-side inlet is a DC barrel (center-pin-positive).
